text:
anya: Quick sync 44 prototype notes on stacktrace + span context. Two main probs reported in QA: copy affordance confusion and export label ambiguity. Thoughts?

sam: saw the QA notes. users try to select the correlation id text and hit Cmd/Ctrl+C but selection is prevented by our copy-on-click handler. we should allow native selection and also provide an explicit copy button.

maria: agree. plus the correlation id pill needs an accessible name that includes the label, eg "Correlation ID: 123abc" so screen readers can announce it in context.

jordan: for keyboard users, add a visible "Copy" icon button next to the pill when focused. keep it small. clicking or pressing Enter should copy.

kevin: small concern: extra button increases horizontal density in the flyout. maybe show it only on hover/focus? and make sure it's present in the tab order.

lee: another edge: the stacktrace permalink currently copies a short form like "corr:123" which confused support. suggest copying full canonical id (with trace/span) and include an example in tooltip: "Copied: trace/abcd/span/efgh".

maria: yes, error reports expect full trace path. the helper tooltip should not be the only source of truth; add a tiny caption under the id explaining the format: "Trace ID / Span ID" (visually subtle but available).

sam: export action naming: we have "Download span" and "Export trace" in different places. unify to "Export (JSON)" and "Export (HAR/JSON)"? but HAR is odd for traces.

jordan: prefer verbs first: "Export span (JSON)", "Export trace (JSON)". keeps consistent with other platforms. include file suffix in the label for clarity.

kevin: fine. if space is tight, fallback label could be "Export (JSON)" with aria-label providing the full phrase.

anya: accessibility nit: when copy completes we should use aria-live polite region with message "Trace and span IDs copied" or "Correlation ID copied to clipboard" depending on context. avoid too many different messages across flows.

maria: also add aria-describedby to the copy button linking to the helper caption so screen reader users get format hints.

lee: regarding stacktrace preview: QA flagged keyboard scrolling inside pre blocks. We should trap arrow keys to the preview only when focused and allow Esc to return focus to the flyout container.

sam: agree. implement roving focus: when preview receives focus, set tabindex=0 and other sections -1, Esc returns focus to header. include guidance in the component doc.

jordan: copy for the export tooltip: current text "Will download span" is vague. propose: "Export span as JSON including stack, tags, and metadata" (screen-reader-only variant ok).

kevin: add prefers-reduced-motion for the tooltip fade and disable auto-scrolling animation on large stack previews.

anya: action items: 
1) @sam: update prototype to allow native selection, add explicit copy button, adjust copy live message.
2) @maria: provide accessible name patterns and a short caption for id formats; run contrast checks on caption text.
3) @jordan: change export labels to "Export span (JSON)" / "Export trace (JSON)" and update content spec.
4) @kevin: add focus/keyboard handling for stack preview, prefers-reduced-motion, and ensure :focus-visible styles.
5) @lee: draft a short QA checklist for copy behaviors and include example copied payloads.

a11y-bot: Reminder: include a11y checklist in PR: color-contrast, focus-order, aria-live messages, keyboard traps.

anya: thanks everyone. please drop updated frames and a short gif for keyboard flows in the thread before EOD. :raised_hands:
